    AI Overview
    Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ) tracks the NASDAQ-100 Index, providing concentrated exposure to100+ top non-financial NASDAQ companies, heavily weighted toward technology (over 50-60%). As of March 2026, top holdings include Nvidia, Apple, Microsoft, and Amazon, with the top 10 representing ~47-53% of the portfolio. 
    Key QQQ Holdings (Approximate Weights as of March 2026): 
    • NVIDIA Corp (NVDA): ~8.6% - 9.9%
    • Apple Inc (AAPL): ~7.3% - 8.8%
    • Microsoft Corp (MSFT): ~5.7% - 7.6%
    • Amazon.com Inc (AMZN): ~4.4% - 5.1%
    • Meta Platforms (META): ~3.5%
    • Broadcom Inc (AVGO): ~3.0% - 5.9%
    • Tesla Inc (TSLA): ~3.7%
    • Alphabet Inc (GOOG/GOOGL): ~3.3% - 3.5%
    • Walmart Inc (WMT): ~3.2% 
    Sector Allocation & Fund Characteristics: 
    • Technology: ~51-64%
    • Communication Services: ~16%
    • Consumer Discretionary: ~12-18%
    • Key Features: Highly concentrated in mega-cap technology and growth stocks, making it sensitive to tech sector performance.
    • Expense Ratio: 0.18% 
    The fund is heavily utilized for growth-oriented portfolios and offers high liquidity.

      AI Overview
      +5
      ProShares UltraPro QQQ (TQQQ)
      is a high-risk, leveraged exchange-traded fund (ETF) seeking
      the daily performance of the NASDAQ-100 Index. Designed for short-term trading, it magnifies gains and losses, carries a 0.97% expense ratio, and is subject to volatility decay, making it unsuitable for long-term "buy-and-hold" investors. 
      Key TQQQ Details 
      • Leverage:
        (Triple) Daily NASDAQ-100.
      • Focus: Tech-heavy, tracking companies like Apple, Microsoft, and Amazon.
      • Volatility: Extremely high; can experience massive, rapid drawdowns.
      • Best Use: Short-term tactical, day-trading, or hedging tool.
      • Risk:
        Due to daily reset, long-term performance can differ significantly from
        the index return over that same period.
         
      TQQQ vs. QQQ 
      • TQQQ (ProShares UltraPro QQQ):
        daily return, high risk, high fees (0.97%), volatile.
      • QQQ (Invesco QQQ Trust):
        return (tracks the index directly), lower risk, lower fees (0.20%).         
      Disclaimer: Leveraged ETFs like TQQQ are complex financial instruments and are generally not recommended for novice investors.
